AGA-I contends that the police authorities in compliance of the directions issued by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 46998 of 2020 (Junaid Vs State of U.P. and another) reported at 2021 (6) ADJ 511 and with a view to implement the provisions of POCSO Act, 2012 read with POCSO Rules, 2020, have served the bail application upon the victim/legal guardian as well as upon the CWC.

sentences.text: By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.76 of 2023 at Police Station-Ahiraula, District-Azamgarh under Sections 376, 457, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is in jail since 31.03.2023.

The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 24.04.2023.

sentences.text:
The following arguments made by Shri Rajkapoor Upadhyay, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Jitendra Kumar, learned counsel for the informant and Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. Learned counsel for the applicant contests the minority of the victim as depicted in the prosecution case.
2. The age of the victim shown in the F.I.R. is 17 years.
The applicant was falsely implicated under the stringent provisions of the POCSO Act and cause his imprisonment.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant contests the age of the victim set out in the prosecution case in light of the judgement of this Court in Monish Vs. State of U.P.
and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021) and on the following grounds:
(i) There are material contradictions in the age of the victim as recorded in various prosecution documents.

entities.text:
Monish Vs. State of U.P.
and others (Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 55026 of 2021)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (ii) The age of the victim was incorrectly got registered in the school records by the victim's parents to give her an advantage in life.
The school records disclosing her age as 16 years 8 months are unreliable.
(iii) The victim in her statements under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has asserted that she is 17 years of age.

(iv) No medical examination to determine the correct age of the victim as per the latest scientific criteria and medical protocol by eminent doctors from a reputed institution was got done by the prosecution as it would establish the majority of the victim and falsify the prosecution case.
The victim is in fact a major.
4. The F.I.R. arises out of a petty neighbourhood dispute.
5. The criminal case is being leveraged to force the applicant to settle the dispute on terms of the first informant.
6. The F.I.R. does not make any allegation of commission of rape against the applicant.
7. The victim in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. has not made any commission of rape by the applicant with her.
8. Subsequently, false and aggravated allegations were made in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. at the behest of her parents to save the failing prosecution case.

entities.text: Kush @ Gorelal vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2 7. The material contradictions in the F.I.R., statements of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C. and under Section 164 Cr.P.C. discredit the prosecution case.
8. No medical evidence to corroborate the commission of rape by the applicant has been produced by the prosecution.
9. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
10. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Kush @ Gorelal be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Ashish Tripathi  Kush @ Gorelal vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39882766/
